name: ad-group-member-win
description: Practice-box helper (Active Directory, DC-only): adds a domain account to a domain group. Vars: GROUP (required, e.g. 'Domain Admins'); USERNAME (required, SamAccountName of an existing account). Idempotent: membership is checked before adding. Domain Admin elevation of a rogue or stale account is a classic privilege-escalation finding. Must run AFTER the account exists (pair with ad-user-win). Pairs with powershell_json checks over Get-ADGroupMember / Get-ADUser -Properties MemberOf.
